evidence.finding: Installed package declares version 0.3.1, Apache-2.0 metadata license, and the drumath2237/spz-loader repository.
The SPZ submodule points to https://github.com/nianticlabs/spz.git.
The tag tree records packages/core/lib/spz-wasm/spz as a mode-160000 gitlink at cc5671d716740e02d57816d4a4a38d164926e695.
The Emscripten build uses WASM=1, SINGLE_FILE=1 and USE_ZLIB=1.

limitations: The package's Apache-2.0 metadata does not replace the embedded Niantic SPZ component's MIT license.
The upstream tag/submodule relationship is source provenance, not proof of a reproducible source-to-binary build for the recorded WASM hash.
This record is not a complete linked-component SBOM; zlib, compiler/runtime support and other linked components require separate provenance and license review.
Prebuilt worker source labels do not establish exact dependency versions. Cesium ThirdParty.json is incomplete/stale; not treated as a full SBOM.
Rust/WASM source-to-binary reproducibility and the complete linked dependency graph were not established. See supplemental notes.
